description_en: Restarts a single node of an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
name: RestartNode

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. 
If the instance is a sharded cluster instance, you must also specify NodeId
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。 
如果是分片集群实例，您还需要配置`NodeId`
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the mongos, shard, or config server node in a sharded cluster instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html operation to query the node ID of the mongos, shard, or config server node.

This parameter is required when DBInstanceId is set to instance ID of a sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Mongos节点ID、Shard节点ID或ConfigServer节点ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html接口查询Mongos节点、Shard节点或ConfigServer节点的节点ID。

当DBInstanceId配置的是分片集群实例ID时，需要配置该参数
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The role ID of the node.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468469.html operation to query the node ID of a replica set instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468472.html operation to query the node ID of a sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
节点的角色ID.

可以调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468469.html 接口查询副本集实例的节点ID。
可以调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468472.html 接口查询分片集群实例的节点ID
parameters.name: role_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can generate the value of this parameter on the client side. The value must be unique across different requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length. The value cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符，且该参数值中不能包含非 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without calling the operation. The system checks the request parameters, request format, service limits, and inventory. If the request fails the dry run, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false: sends a normal request. If the request passes the dry run, the operation is directly performed.
Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次请求执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查，不真正调用该接口。检查项包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接执行本次操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The execution time. Valid values:
0: executes the operation immediately. This is the default value.
1: executes the operation during the maintenance window.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html operation to modify the maintenance window of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
执行时间，取值：
0：立即执行，默认值。
1：在可维护时间段执行。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html修改实例的可维护时间段
parameters.name: switch_mode
